description: This file serves as the development entry point for a Qwik application, handling client-side rendering without server-side rendering features. It imports rendering functions from Qwik, a root component, and exports a default function that initiates rendering with provided options.

methods.name: default
methods.description: A function that renders the root component `<Root />` into the document using Qwik's render function, taking rendering options as its parameter.
